chatGate.pageIntro: Keep hate raids out of your chat by asking for a little real watching first.
chatGate.loadFailed: Chat safety settings could not be loaded.
chatGate.offDescription: The operator of this instance has not enabled the verified-watch gate or the surge guard yet.
chatGate.gate.title: Verified-watch gate
chatGate.gate.intro: Only signed-in viewers who have actually been watching this broadcast for a while can chat. It never tells anyone how close they are.
chatGate.gate.offDescription: The operator of this instance has not enabled the verified-watch gate.
chatGate.gate.secondsHint: 0 turns the gate off; otherwise 60 to 3600 seconds.
chatGate.gate.exemptSubsHint: Your subscribers can chat without having watched first.
chatGate.gate.who: Viewers must watch signed in for it to count. It never applies to you, your moderators or your VIPs.
chatGate.surge.title: Surge guard
chatGate.surge.intro: When many unverified viewers arrive at once, chat turns watchers-only for a while. Earlier chatters, subscribers and your team are not affected, and your moderators can end it with one click.
chatGate.surge.offDescription: The operator of this instance has not enabled the surge guard.
chatGate.surge.enabledHint: Off by default. It needs a minute of verified watching while it is active.
chatGate.surge.ratioHint: 10 to 100. Of the new viewers in the last two minutes, this share not verified starts surge mode.
chatGate.surge.cooldownHint: 1 to 120. Surge mode ends this long after the last surge.
chatGate.saveFailed: Chat safety settings could not be saved
chatGate.error.seconds: Enter 0, or a whole number from 60 to 3600.
chatGate.error.ratio: Enter a whole number from 10 to 100.
chatGate.error.cooldown: Enter a whole number from 1 to 120.
surge.hint: This chat is for viewers who have been watching for a little while. Watch signed in to join in.
surge.onBody: Many new viewers arrived who are not verified yet, so only viewers who have watched for a minute can chat. Earlier chatters, subscribers and your team are not affected.
surge.suppressedBody: A moderator ended surge mode. It will not start again on its own before it resumes.
surge.unavailable: The verified-watch check is unavailable right now, so chat is open to everyone.
surge.failed: Surge mode could not be changed
